about: atlas-core domain invariants across adapter capabilities, handles, turn/request/limit, sessions/rotation, threads, subagent trees, boot reconciliation, and live cutover.

mutants.name: atlas-core-adapter-emulates-steer
mutants.rule: Adapters must never emulate unsupported steer operations when Capabilities.Steer is false.

mutants.name: atlas-core-adapter-yolo-fallback-skips-supervised
mutants.rule: Unsupported ModeYolo requests must fall back strictly to ModeSupervised rather than proceeding.

mutants.name: atlas-core-adapter-allows-unsupported-direct-agy
mutants.rule: Direct Antigravity must remain gated off unless Capabilities.OfficiallySupported is true.

mutants.name: atlas-core-continuation-drops-claude-config-dir
mutants.rule: Distinct Claude config directories must produce distinct continuation keys so accounts do not alias.

mutants.name: atlas-core-handle-delivers-routes-shell-to-registry
mutants.rule: DELIVERS maps KindShell solely to DelivererShellHost, never DelivererRegistry.

mutants.name: atlas-core-handle-handed-emits-wake
mutants.rule: DispHanded transitions a call cleanly into a child handle without emitting a wake letter.

mutants.name: atlas-core-handle-retire-owner-retires-other-owners
mutants.from: if hv.Owner == deadOwner && hv.Kind == KindCall && IsOpen(hv.Disposition) {
mutants.rule: Retiring one dead owner settles only that owner's volatile KindCall handles and keeps other owners live.

mutants.name: atlas-core-turn-allows-retry-after-first-delta
mutants.rule: A turn must never retry after its first output delta has arrived.

mutants.name: atlas-core-turn-allows-finish-with-stranded-stop
mutants.rule: Dispatched turns with StopWanted set must issue a driver cancel rather than ending stranded.

mutants.name: atlas-core-turn-skips-write-approval-gate
mutants.rule: ExecuteWrite must enforce PermissionMode and ApprovalGranted via adapter.RequireWriteApproval.

mutants.name: atlas-core-request-delivers-to-dead-session
mutants.rule: Buffered interactive request answers must never be delivered to a dead or detached session.

mutants.name: atlas-core-limit-allows-overdue-24h-arm
mutants.rule: Limit recovery must refuse to arm stale resets overdue beyond 24 hours.

mutants.name: atlas-core-limit-resumes-on-expired-session
mutants.rule: Auto-resume must never fire when the session is already expired.

mutants.name: atlas-core-session-mcp-accepts-expired-token
mutants.rule: Per-thread /mcp tokens expire after 24 hours idle without a real turn touch.

mutants.name: atlas-core-rotation-switches-fixed-account
mutants.rule: Threads configured with RotationFixed must never move off their pinned account.

mutants.name: atlas-core-rotation-switches-mid-turn
mutants.rule: Account rotation must never occur while a turn is active on the thread.

mutants.name: atlas-core-thread-allows-concurrent-turns
mutants.rule: A single thread must never run two concurrent active turns.

mutants.name: atlas-core-thread-link-origin-bypasses-mcp-fence
mutants.from:
case OriginMcpScoped as scoped:
			mcp.ThreadID == scoped.BoundThread && mcp.ThreadID == t.ID
mutants.rule: D63 LinkOrigin fencing must reject limited /mcp callers for any thread outside their bound scope.

mutants.name: atlas-core-subagent-allows-handback-with-open-handles
mutants.rule: A subagent child must achieve zero final hand-back while still holding open handles.

mutants.name: atlas-core-subagent-allows-sibling-subtree-control
mutants.rule: Subagent control operations must stay strictly inside the caller's own descendant subtree.

mutants.name: atlas-core-reconcile-drops-live-foreign-calls
mutants.from: let isForeignLive = h.Owner != snap.BootingOwner && containsOwner(snap.LiveForeignOwners, h.Owner)
mutants.rule: BootReconcile must leave open KindCall handles owned by live peer owners untouched.

mutants.name: atlas-core-reconcile-replays-delivered-wake
mutants.rule: BootReconcile must never re-deliver wakes whose immutable DeliveryID was already delivered.

mutants.name: atlas-core-cutover-allows-abort-after-commit
mutants.rule: Cutover must refuse rollback once CommitPersisted has recorded New ownership.

mutants.name: atlas-core-cutover-allows-old-act-in-transfer
mutants.rule: Cutover must fence Old from mutating state in transfer and after commit.

mutants.name: atlas-store-idempotent-cmd-ignores-payload
mutants.rule: Reusing a committed CommandID with a different payload must fail CommandReused rather than acting as an idempotent no-op.

mutants.name: atlas-store-lease-fence-allows-stale-owner
mutants.rule: Fenced writes must fail LeaseFenced when owner, epoch, or fencing token mismatches the durable lease.

mutants.name: atlas-store-lease-fence-allows-transfer-window
mutants.rule: Fenced writes must fail LeaseFenced while the lease is in CutoverTransfer handoff.

mutants.name: atlas-store-hold-wake-before-retry-at
mutants.rule: Waiting quota PoolHolds must reject HoldActionWake prior to RetryAtMs.

mutants.name: atlas-store-pool-reset-double-claim
mutants.rule: Pool reset dispatch claims must accept at most one winner per (account, window_kind, period_key).

mutants.name: atlas-store-pool-inflight-allows-negative
mutants.rule: PoolAccount.InflightStarts must never decrement below zero.

mutants.name: atlas-store-kernel-snapshot-exceeds-cap
mutants.rule: Kernel snapshots exceeding MaxKernelSnapshotBytes must be refused.

mutants.name: atlas-store-kernel-root-share-flag-dropped
mutants.rule: Kernel cuts breaching the hourly root execution share threshold must flag KernelRootUsage and KernelCutJournal.

mutants.name: atlas-store-query-active-push-ignores-end-bound
mutants.rule: Time-boxed OwnerPush windows are half-open [StartsAtMs, EndsAtMs) and expire at EndsAtMs.

mutants.name: atlas-store-query-due-hold-skips-retry-equality
mutants.rule: PoolHolds become due cleanly at nowMs == RetryAtMs.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-skip-command-reused
mutants.rule: SQLite store must return CommandReused when an existing CommandID is replayed with a differing payload.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-scope-drops-lease-fence
mutants.rule: SQLite write scope loader must load the fenced lease record before calling Decide.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-schema-fence-bypass
mutants.rule: SQLite store must refuse opening databases whose schema_meta or user_version does not match CurrentSchemaVersion.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-user-version-without-meta-allowed
mutants.rule: SQLite store must refuse non-zero PRAGMA user_version databases lacking schema_meta.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-prompt-queue-skips-delete
mutants.from: let _ = try execTx("DELETE FROM prompt_queue WHERE thread_id = ?", []sql.Value{sql.Text{S: string(t.ID)}})
mutants.to: let _ = try execTx("DELETE FROM prompt_queue WHERE thread_id = ? AND 1 = 0", []sql.Value{sql.Text{S: string(t.ID)}})
mutants.rule: Thread prompt_queue projection must clear stale queue entries on rewrite to avoid phantom queued prompts.

mutants.name: atlas-store-sqlite-boot-drops-lost-wake-flag
mutants.rule: BootReconcile SQLite projection must persist wake_emitted = 1 when settling lost KindCall handles.

mutants.name: atlas-api-hmac-equal-skipped
mutants.rule: Bearer authentication must verify SHA-256 token digests with constant-time hmac.Equal rather than accepting any 32-byte digest record.

mutants.name: atlas-api-revoked-token-accepted
mutants.rule: Revoked /mcp bearer tokens must be rejected with HTTP 401 token_revoked after rotation or close.

mutants.name: atlas-api-wrong-thread-bypass
mutants.rule: Per-thread /mcp routes must reject bearer tokens issued for any other thread with HTTP 403 wrong_thread.

mutants.name: atlas-api-idle-24h-not-enforced
mutants.rule: D11: /mcp bearer credentials must expire after 24h without turn execution and must not be extended by /mcp requests alone.

mutants.name: atlas-api-outside-audience-thread-tool-allowed
mutants.rule: D13: thread-only tools called by an outside-agent audience must be explicitly refused in the MCP tool handler.

mutants.name: atlas-api-cross-thread-tool-arg-bypass
mutants.rule: Scoped thread /mcp callers must be refused when targeting unrelated threadIDs inside MCP tool arguments.

mutants.name: atlas-api-archive-skips-token-revoke
mutants.from:
let _ = try execStore(s, meta, memory.CmdArchiveThread{ID: tid})
	let _ = RevokeThreadTokens(s.auth, tid)
mutants.to: let _ = try execStore(s, meta, memory.CmdArchiveThread{ID: tid})
mutants.rule: Archiving/closing a thread must revoke active per-thread /mcp bearer credentials.

mutants.name: atlas-api-wellness-skips-dead-owner-calls
mutants.rule: WellnessReport must flag open volatile KindCall handles belonging to non-live owners.

mutants.name: atlas-api-wellness-skips-host-load-check
mutants.from:
let lpc = LoadPerCore(rep)
	let loadOK = lpc <= policy.MaxLoadPerCore
mutants.to:
let lpc = LoadPerCore(rep)
	let loadOK = true || lpc <= policy.MaxLoadPerCore
mutants.rule: WellnessReport and WellnessMonitor must detect excessive host 1m load-per-core headroom.

mutants.name: atlas-api-host-capacity-allows-invalid-bounds
mutants.rule: HostCapacity must validate that available memory does not exceed total host memory.

mutants.name: atlas-api-bind-allows-wildcard
mutants.rule: HTTP server bind policy must refuse wildcard 0.0.0.0 addresses and permit only loopback or Tailscale CGNAT.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-weekly-target-over-99
mutants.rule: Shared fleet weekly pace line targets 99% of capacity, never 100%.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-weekly-leeway-not-5
mutants.rule: Shared weekly pace model grants 5% (50,000 ppm) shared fleet leeway.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-claim-lowers-pace-line
mutants.rule: Rebasing or claiming on an account must never lower its natural pace line.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-soonest-reset-reversed
mutants.rule: Eligible under-line accounts must be preferred in soonest-resetting ascending order.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-inflight-spend-ignored
mutants.rule: Fleet pace admission must count unsettled starts (inflightSpend) to prevent concurrent double-spend.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-refusal-returns-now-as-retry-at
mutants.from: return AdmitHeld{RetryAtMs: earliestCatchUpOrHardRetry(ranked, ledger, req), Reason: reason}
mutants.rule: Door refusal must name a concrete retryAt strictly in the future (RetryAtMs > nowMs).

mutants.name: atlas-pool-early-wake-before-opening
mutants.rule: Held turns must never wake before RetryAtMs opens.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-double-wake-lost-reply
mutants.rule: Atomic wakeDeliveryId ledger must block double-wake at now == retryAt even after lost reply.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-gone-child-duplicate-parent-notice
mutants.rule: Gone held child must notify its parent at most once without duplicate notices.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-gone-child-phantom-wake
mutants.from: let nh, nl, eff = ProbeChildGoneHold(hold, ledger, nowMs)
mutants.to: let nh, nl, eff = EvaluateHoldWake(hold, ledger, nowMs)
mutants.rule: Gone held child must never receive a phantom wake.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-gone-archived-child-woken-in-store
mutants.to:
case option.Some as vw:
		false && vw.Value.Thread.Archived
mutants.rule: Durable store reconciliation must cancel archived/gone children and emit one parent notice instead of waking them.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-pending-question-wakes-hold
mutants.rule: Open async questions on a held child must block waking until answered.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-duplicate-reset-claim-per-period
mutants.rule: Exhaustion reset dispatch allows at most one claim per account, window, and period.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-period-jitter-not-absorbed
mutants.rule: PeriodKey must absorb sub-half-hour provider reset timestamp jitter.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-push-active-past-end
mutants.from: !push.Cancelled && push.EndsAtMs > push.StartsAtMs && nowMs >= push.StartsAtMs && nowMs < push.EndsAtMs
mutants.to: !push.Cancelled && push.EndsAtMs > push.StartsAtMs && nowMs >= push.StartsAtMs && nowMs <= push.EndsAtMs
mutants.rule: Time-boxed owner push uses half-open [StartsAtMs, EndsAtMs) and expires strictly at EndsAtMs.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-carryover-revives-expired-window
mutants.rule: Carry-over across partial limit updates must never revive expired pre-reset windows.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-fixed-account-escapes-pin
mutants.rule: RotationFixed policy must keep placement restricted to FixedAccount without moving to another account.

mutants.name: atlas-pool-rotation-allows-mid-turn-switch
mutants.rule: Account rotation must be blocked while a thread turn is active.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-120s-wait-bound
mutants.rule: Kernel wait budget must stay bounded at 120s (120000ms).

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-30s-compute-bound
mutants.rule: Kernel synchronous compute bound must stay capped at 30s (30000ms).

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-10m-ask-bound
mutants.rule: Kernel asking wait bound must be 10m (600000ms).

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-cut-skips-wait-trigger
mutants.rule: Non-automation cells reaching wait bound must cut before entering another wait.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-unfinished-runs-instead-of-handed
mutants.rule: Cutting a cell with active handles must transition Unfinished -> Handed cleanly.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-clean-restore-emits-notice
mutants.rule: Clean restore with no lost bindings must emit zero lost-bindings notice.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-lost-bindings-exceeds-160
mutants.rule: Lost-bindings notices must remain strictly capped at 160 characters.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-root-waits-on-subagents
mutants.rule: Root agents must be prevented from blocking on subagents.wait.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-worker-pool-exceeds-32
mutants.rule: Worker role kernel concurrency pool must stay bounded at 32 slots.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-32-slot-queues-root
mutants.rule: Root threads must never wait on the 32-worker slot queue.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-hourly-15pct-never-flags
mutants.rule: Per-root hourly kernel usage exceeding 15% must raise a warning flag once per hour.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-delivers-routes-host-to-registry
mutants.rule: DELIVERS registry must refuse opening host-owned handle kinds under DelivererRegistry.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-2s-burst-fires-early
mutants.rule: Burst wake coalescing window must remain 2000ms so wakes never fire early.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-wake-letter-exceeds-2000
mutants.rule: Coalesced wake letters must never exceed 2000 chars.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-handed-double-wakes
mutants.rule: Handed and already-settled handles must settle idempotently without re-waking.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-deleted-session-wakes
mutants.rule: Deleted sessions must suppress all pending wake letters silently.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-ask-allows-blocking-question
mutants.rule: Blocking question tool must remain refused across every agent role.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-ask-drops-assumption-check
mutants.rule: ask_user_async must require an explicit non-empty working assumption.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-withdraw-emits-wake
mutants.rule: Withdrawing an open async question must silently cancel its handle without waking.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-queue-drops-steer-priority
mutants.rule: Steer prompts must queue strictly ahead of normal FIFO prompts.

mutants.name: atlas-kernel-wake-queue-allows-cancelled-requeue
mutants.rule: Cancelling a queued prompt must record its ID as cancelled without disturbing remaining FIFO items.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-guard-allows-rm-repo-root
mutants.rule: Destructive rm guard must refuse deleting repository roots or containing ancestors.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-guard-unreadable-repos-fails-open
mutants.rule: Destructive rm guard must fail closed when repository roots are unreadable.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-guard-allows-git-reset-hard
mutants.rule: Git guard must refuse git reset --hard.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-guard-allows-git-worktree-add
mutants.from:
if applies {
			return option.Some[GuardError]{Value: FullCopy{Rule: RuleWorktreeAdd, Reason: "repository uses CoW workspaces; use `work new <name>` instead of `git worktree add`"}}
mutants.to:
if false && applies {
			return option.Some[GuardError]{Value: FullCopy{Rule: RuleWorktreeAdd, Reason: "repository uses CoW workspaces; use `work new <name>` instead of `git worktree add`"}}
mutants.rule: Workspace guard must refuse git worktree add with FullCopy where CoW workspaces apply.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-guard-allows-bare-work-gc
mutants.rule: Work guard must refuse bare work gc while permitting work rm <lane>.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-guard-allows-server-kill
mutants.rule: Server-PID kill guard must refuse signals targeting protected server/daemon PIDs.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-guard-allows-subagent-long-sleep
mutants.rule: Subagent foreground sleep >= 30s must be refused with Idle.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-guard-allows-chrome-without-mock-keychain
mutants.rule: Chrome launch guard must require BOTH --use-mock-keychain and --password-store=basic.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-tools-allows-blocking-question
mutants.rule: Tool parser must reject blocking question invocations with BlockingQuestionError.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-tools-yolo-bypasses-guard
mutants.from:
case guard.GuardError as ge:
		return GuardBlockedError{Cause: ge}
mutants.to:
case guard.GuardError as ge:
		let _ = ge
mutants.rule: Shell safety guard must remain non-bypassable even under PermissionMode yolo.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-tools-ask-auto-approves-edit
mutants.rule: PermissionMode ask and supervised must require confirmation for workspace edits.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-tools-auto-edit-allows-shell
mutants.to:
case adapter.ModeAutoEdit:
		PolicyAllow
	case adapter.ModeAsk, adapter.ModeSupervised:
mutants.rule: PermissionMode auto_edit must still ask confirmation before executing shell commands.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-tools-barrier-allows-stale-read-batch
mutants.rule: Read-only parallel batches must enforce ordered barriers before mutating tool calls.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-tools-subagent-allows-handback-open-handles
mutants.rule: Subagent hand_back must fail while child holds open handles or active descendants.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-direct-retries-after-first-delta
mutants.rule: Direct loop must never retry an LLM stream request after emitting >= 1 delta (NoRetryAfterFirstDelta).

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-direct-allows-unsupported-agy
mutants.rule: Direct loop must reject AntigravityDirect upfront when direct Antigravity is unsupported.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-direct-compaction-splits-tool-group
mutants.rule: Branch compaction must keep Assistant tool calls paired atomically with their Result messages.

mutants.name: atlas-direct-loop-direct-drops-parent-thread-id
mutants.from:
let childCfg = DirectConfig{
		..parentCfg,
		ThreadID:       spec.ChildID,
		ParentThreadID: option.Some[handle.ThreadID]{Value: parentCfg.ThreadID},
mutants.to:
let childCfg = DirectConfig{
		..parentCfg,
		ThreadID:       spec.ChildID,
		ParentThreadID: option.None,
mutants.rule: Spawned subagent child thread must carry ParentThreadID pointing to its spawning parent thread.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-enables-antigravity-by-default
mutants.rule: Default official support gate must keep Antigravity/Gemini direct explicitly gated off unless officially supported.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-allows-proxy-origin-override
mutants.rule: Direct providers must never accept custom base URLs or proxy origins (spec §0 never proxy).

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-allows-proxy-headers-and-env
mutants.rule: Direct providers must reject proxy forwarding, host-override, and raw credential headers.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-allows-account-rotation
mutants.rule: Pinned direct sessions must never rotate or switch accounts mid-session (spec §0 never account rotation).

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-conflates-opencode-go-and-console-paths
mutants.rule: OpenCode Go and OpenCode Console must retain distinct official subscription API paths.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-clears-rate-limit-reset-timestamp
mutants.rule: HTTP 429 rate-limit failures must classify as FailureUsageLimit preserving computed future ResetAtMs.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-accepts-duplicate-tool-call-ids
mutants.rule: Completed model turns must reject duplicate tool-call IDs.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-codex-truncated-returns-empty-text
mutants.rule: Truncated Codex Responses streams must preserve partial delta text already emitted.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-anthropic-truncated-drops-partial-text
mutants.rule: Truncated Anthropic Messages streams must preserve partial delta text already emitted.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-openai-ignores-missing-done-truncation
mutants.rule: OpenAI Chat Completions streams without terminal [DONE] or finish_reason must fail Truncated.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-pool-allows-non-usage-reset-timestamp
mutants.to:
case llm.Overloaded, llm.Unauthorized, llm.Refused:
		turn.FailureUsageLimit{ResetAtMs: nowMs + int64(60000)}
mutants.rule: Non-usage failures must keep FailureResetAtMs as None per D8.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-pool-admission-rotates-to-standby
mutants.to:
let _ = entry
	let pinnedReg = spec.Registry
	let costPpm = if spec.EstimatedCostPpm > 0 { spec.EstimatedCostPpm } else { pool.DefaultCostPpm() }
	let req = pool.PlacementRequest{
		Provider:         DriverPoolProviderName(spec.Driver),
		Model:            string(spec.Model),
		NowMs:            spec.NowMs,
		EstimatedCostPpm: costPpm,
		PreferredAccount: option.None,
mutants.rule: Pinned direct session admission must never leak standby accounts into pool placement.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-pool-drops-429-hold-until-ms
mutants.rule: Usage-limit failure settlement must arm a concrete future pool hold on the pinned account.

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-retries-stream-after-first-delta
mutants.rule: Direct provider stream guard must never retry once >= 1 delta has reached the sink (NoRetryAfterFirstDelta).

mutants.name: atlas-provider-direct-emulates-unsupported-capabilities
mutants.rule: Direct client wiring into modules/atlas/direct must preserve Adapter.Capabilities without capability emulation.
